text:
amara: hey folks — bit of personal news: accepted the Sr PM offer! also... we're expecting a baby in Sept 🍼🎉 would love a tiny celebration. potluck next week? :party-parrot:
beau: wait WHAT? congrats x1000!!! when's the target date? and happy promo!!!! :tada::confetti_ball:
amara: due date Sept 10, official title starts Aug 1. thinking Fri Sep 12 noon in the kitchen? short + kid-friendly :)
jin: count me in — i'll bring gf brownies and coffee. need me to order anything? @people-ops-bot can we reserve the kitchen?
people-ops-bot: Event created by @jin: 'Amara — promo + baby potluck' on 2025-09-12 12:00-13:00. Room: Kitchen. RSVP: https://calendar.company/internal/ev/2105436789
lina: omg cake debate: lemon vs chocolate vs tres leches? poll time 🎂
beau: lemon for baby, chocolate for promo. both. two cakes. :innocent: (would be dramatic)
maria: i volunteer to make a tiny baby-themed cake (non-alcoholic frosting). any allergies in the room?
jin: no nuts for me pls. i'll label ingredients and bring gf options.
amara: you all are the best. also tiny gift? optional. pls don't feel pressured. :heart:
beau: :thumbsup: will bring flowers. also can someone snap pics? would be lovely.
lina: i'll be the designated photographer 📸
